FestivalsFestivals and cultural events in Ghana A directory of {{count}} traditional festivals and cultural events across {{regionCount}} of Ghana’s 16 regions, January to December. For each one: where it happens, when it usually falls, who keeps it and what to expect.

To do this year

  • watch the deer hunt at Winneba
  • eat kpokpoi at Homowo
  • see the umbrellas at Fetu Afahye
  • Fiok at Sandema in December

Most festivals are kept by a town and its chiefs, who set the date close to the day.
